item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs mdel kha gsang ba'i tan tra bsrung ba'i go cha a dkar gsang ba
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs mdel kha gsang ba'i tan tra las bsrung ba'i go cha bstan pa'o / 'chi med gshen gsum gyi gdung don / sde brgyad gyi phyag len / lha klu mi gsum snang mdog dang bzhi la rgyud do / de lha'i gshen gsum / de zhang zhung gshen gsum / de rgya bod sgom gshen gsum / des phrom bod zhang zhung gsum / de so ldeng mi nyag gsum / de dran pa nam mkha' / de stang chen dmu tsha gyer med / phyi rabs kyi las ldan nam mkha' rin chen / de rims par brgyud nas da lta nya [~bdag] la'o …
item.note: protective mantras. given the information in the colphon, this must have been concealed by dmu-tsha gyer-med, and excavated by nam-mkha' rin-chen. notice in the colophon the use of the shorthand form nya (although here it looks more like the tibetan form of the number '3') in place of the word 'i' (bdag). this nam-mkha' rin-chen is probably to be identified as blo-ldan snying-po, although there are some other possibilities.
